description: Prepare a message to a person for review. Sends NOTHING. Use this whenever YOU wrote the words (from the work in this session, or as an answer to a message that arrived): pass handle + message, and reply_to when it answers a specific message. Returns the exact preview and the three choices: Send / Edit / Cancel. Show the preview and ask in words; a pick in a question menu does not count as the person's choice. To edit, call again with the draft id and the new message. A changed draft must be shown again before it can be sent: show the person the new preview and wait for their next message. If the handle is not on /vibe yet, the preview says so and the message is held for that GitHub account instead. To bring someone new with one real question, pass invite: true and the message, with no handle: the preview says it goes to whoever uses that invite line, and Keep makes the line. Set asked: true only when the person's latest message asked for this message or agreed to it; when you offer it unprompted, your reply must first give the person everything their message asked for, in full, and show the draft after that, never instead of it.

asked.description: true only if the person's latest message asked for a message to this person or agreed to one (also for a reply); false or absent when you are offering it unprompted.

id.description: An existing draft id, to edit it

invite.description: true, with no handle: the message rides on a new invite line and reaches whoever joins /vibe with that line, once, as the person's first message to them. Previewed and kept like a message held for someone not on /vibe yet. One message per line.

kind.description: Only "landed": a note back to someone whose reply led to a concrete change made in this session. Needs reply_to (their reply). Once per reply. It is a one-sentence receipt of what changed on the person's side: what was actually updated, "not deployed yet" or "local only" when it is not live, and no question, request or instruction to them (a question mark is refused); if nothing changed, do not open one. It changes nothing about how the message is checked or sent.

message.description: The message: 1-3 plain sentences in the person's voice. No file paths, branch names, secrets or transcript text.

project.description: Optional: the name of the work this comes from, kept locally so the reply can be shown beside it. Never sent.

refs.description: Links the person explicitly wants attached

reply_to.description: The id of the message this answers, when it answers one

name: vibe_prepare
